description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/SearchProduct/TerminateListing2. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Provides the POST terminate listing2 operation in existing published product/listing management. Use when: Use it when a client needs to run the terminate listing2 operation for existing published product/listing management. Input: [FromBody] item: TerminateItemRequest. Main fields: Id: int. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Output: Ends the listing in the store. Marks it terminated in HGR and returns success=true only when the store confirms the end or reports that the item was already ended. When the store refuses the end, returns success=false and the listing stays active in HGR. Search terms: terminatelisting 2, searchproduct terminatelisting 2. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

impactConfirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly confirmed the concrete high-impact consequences.
